about.title: About me
about.hero_description: Developer, creative and maker: the same person behind the code, the images, and the tools — what follows tells how the three meet.
about.expertise1_desc: MERN & Next.js, end to end: interface, API, database. I build the whole stack, not just the screen.
about.expertise2_desc: Video end to end — shooting, editing (Premiere Pro, After Effects), color grading — and interface design when the project calls for it.
about.expertise3_desc: Diagnosis, smartphone repair, computer assembly and maintenance. I take apart before I replace.
about.philosophy_default_bio: Not one specialty but three terrains — and I move between them as the project demands.

dev_page.hero_description: Complete architectures that work, last over time, and can evolve without being rebuilt from scratch.
dev_page.service1_desc: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, with Next.js for rendering — the stack I handle end to end.
dev_page.service2_desc: VPS setup, Linux environments, automating system tasks. I work on Linux, macOS and Windows every day.
dev_page.service3_desc: Write a precise prompt, read a model's output, place the tool where it actually helps: that's a skill, and it changes the daily work.
dev_page.stack_description: Personal projects make up most of my practice. I learned by building real things, breaking them, and rebuilding them.
dev_page.step1_desc: We start from what you actually need, then pick the technologies — not the other way around.
dev_page.step2_desc: Database and flows mapped before the first line of code.
dev_page.step3_desc: Delivered in slices, deployed and tested continuously.
dev_page.step4_desc: A careful launch, then active performance monitoring.
dev_page.footer_cta_description: A project to start or something that's stuck: write to me — I answer with a diagnosis, not a brochure.

maker_page.hero_description: Software and hardware. Where many separate the two, I see them as a single reality. A device that no longer works is a problem to be diagnosed methodically.
maker_page.service1_desc: Methodical analysis of hardware failures — screen, battery, charging, motherboard — and component-level repair. No default replacement.
maker_page.service2_desc: Custom workstations, RAM and storage upgrades, cooling, and BIOS settings.
maker_page.service3_desc: Embedded systems built with Arduino, ESP32 or Raspberry Pi. From sensor to web interface, firmware included.
maker_page.footer_cta_description: A device that won't boot, a PC to build, an IoT project: describe it and I'll tell you what's wrong.

designer_page.hero_description: Interfaces you get on first sight, and images you don't forget. Both demand the same thing: precision.
designer_page.exp1_desc: High-fidelity screens, a consistent design system, reusable components. The goal: everything stays readable.
designer_page.exp2_desc: Information architecture, flows and interactive prototypes — so users find their way without thinking about it.
designer_page.exp3_desc: Logos, guidelines and extensions: one clear visual system that holds up on every support.
designer_page.setup_desc1: I shoot with a Panasonic Lumix DMC-G7 in 4K or Full HD as needed, backed by an iPhone 13 Pro Max when things have to stay mobile.
designer_page.setup_desc2: Framing, available light, composition in the moment — that's decided on set. Post-production takes just as much judgment.
designer_page.format1_desc: A wedding is a take you don't get twice. Being quick and being technically ready go together.
designer_page.format2_desc: A documentary is a story built in the edit suite from hours of footage. Rigor and feel.
designer_page.format3_desc: A music video is art direction, rhythm and color grading. Every second carries a visual decision.
designer_page.step1_desc: Finding the best angle and working the light for a cinematic look.
designer_page.step2_desc: Building a story that flows and lands, with rhythm and intent.
designer_page.step3_desc: Color work that gives each project its own clean, consistent look.
designer_page.step4_desc: Encoding tuned to each platform's limits (YouTube, Instagram, web).
designer_page.footer_cta_description: A shoot to plan, an edit to hold together, an identity to set: write to me.
